cases: POST sends persisted UUID and GET DELETE send no URL or request body
Anonymous expiry is login; unowned server failures remain unknown
Malformed announced oversized and invalid UTF8 bodies fail closed
Streamed excess is cancelled without trusting content length
Header stall is bounded at POST310s or recovery30s with no automatic resend
Stalled chunked response shares deadline and cancels reader
Parent abort fences late response and preabort never starts a request
scope: Actual durable-protocol client, native Response/ReadableStream and synthetic fetch/timers. No mounted/native-browser/production or provider claim.
